_note: Merged underneath every product page in this folder (build.py resolve_product). A product JSON overrides any key here. Tokens: {name} = display name, {noun} = the item in a sentence, {care} = 'dryclean care' unless the product sets another, {Care} = title case of it, {seo} = the page's search phrase.

careProcess.title: The 8-Step Wash4You Dryclean Process
careProcess.subtitle: Every dryclean item follows the same path through the Wash4You studio:

steps.title: Tagged
steps.desc: Each piece gets its own Wash4You tag so it is tracked from your door to your return.

steps.title: Detailed Examination
steps.desc: Fibre, colour, pockets, seams, buttons and trims are examined and any marks or damage are noted.

steps.title: Stain Treatment
steps.desc: Marks are pre-treated by hand with the right fabric-safe solution before the machine process.

steps.title: Machine Process
steps.desc: Cleaned on commercial dryclean machines with fabric-safe, biodegradable solvents.

steps.title: Iron & Steam Finish
steps.desc: Hand-finished on steam and vacuum tables to restore shape, crease and drape.

steps.title: Final Check
steps.desc: Every piece passes a final inspection before it is approved for packing.

steps.title: Packaging
steps.desc: Covered and packed to stay fresh until it reaches you.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.desc: Returned to your door in your confirmed slot.

commonFaqs.q: Do you offer pickup and delivery?
commonFaqs.a: Yes. Wash4You provides free doorstep pickup and delivery across Gurugram, Delhi, Noida, Faridabad and Ghaziabad.
Our valet arrives in your selected slot. Your items are inspected and counted in front of you, you get an itemised pickup confirmation, and your order goes into its own separate bag.

commonFaqs.q: Can I book this along with other clothes?
commonFaqs.a: Yes. Add shirts, suits, sarees, bedding, shoes or anything else from the price list to the same pickup, or simply hand them to our valet at the door.

commonFaqs.q: What if I don't know which service to choose?
commonFaqs.a: Pick the closest option. Every piece is inspected when it reaches us, and if a different treatment suits it better we will tell you on WhatsApp or by phone before we start.
